subject: Request: allocate unapplied credit + VAT reclass for Q4 invoices
messages:
From: AeroCloud Billing <accounts@aerocloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unapplied credit on invoices + VAT reclass request

Hi Dylan,

We found an unapplied customer credit of EUR 48,250 that appears to have been posted to a suspense account and not applied against our outstanding invoices for Q4-2026. Invoice references attached (see AeroCloud_applied_credit_report.pdf). Additionally, several invoices were billed with VAT at the incorrect rate (sales tax flagged as "Standard" instead of "Reduced") which affects the VAT reclaim and local filings.

Can Redwood post a journal to reallocate the credit to the correct open invoices and adjust the VAT ledger so our reclaim aligns with local filings? Our accounting team is preparing the contract addendum if you need a copy. This is time-sensitive for our August VAT submission window.

Requested outcomes:
- Apply EUR 48,250 credit across invoice IDs: AC-INV-2026-1123, 1127, 1130
- Post reversing/allocating journal to remove cash suspense posting and apply to AR
- Reclass VAT from "Standard" to "Reduced" where applicable (see attachment annotations)

Thanks,
Marie Dupont
Billing Lead, AeroCloud
accounts@aerocloud.com

Attachment: AeroCloud_applied_credit_report.pdf (PDF stub, 6 pages)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unapplied credit on invoices + VAT reclass request

Thanks Marie — looping in AR and GL to evaluate. Marcus / Lauren / Mina: see AeroCloud's report attached. Summary of ask: apply a EUR 48,250 unapplied credit across three invoices and correct VAT classification on a subset of invoice lines.

My proposal (for discussion):
- Create manual journal JNL-2027-07-AC1: reverse the cash suspense entry (acct 9999) and credit AR ledger, tagging each allocation with the invoice ID and the original payment reference.
- Create VAT adjustment entry JNL-2027-07-VAT1 to move the VAT portion from Standard VAT (acct 4530) to Reduced VAT (acct 4532) for the specific lines.
- Post a memo in the audit notes referencing customer-supplied evidence and include the AeroCloud PDF.

I've sketched a template for the manual journal to avoid rework; attaching proposed_journal_template.csv. Marcus — can you confirm GL accounts and whether any FX revaluation is needed given the invoices were EUR/GBP mixed? Mina — if you can queue the journal, please hold posting until we confirm from tax.

Goal: complete allocations before 2027-07-22 to meet AeroCloud's reclaim timeline.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_journal_template.csv (CSV stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unapplied credit on invoices + VAT reclass request

Agree with the approach. Quick notes after reviewing the AeroCloud file and our GL: 

- Reverse of suspense should debit acct 9999 (Suspense - receipts) and credit AR acct 1200 (Trade Receivables). Allocation lines should reference AC-INV-2026-1123/1127/1130 and include original payment ref: AC-COL-20261130.
- VAT: the impacted lines are confined to invoice 1127 (lines 2 & 4). For those lines, move VAT amount EUR 1,350 from 4530 to 4532. No VAT net change to revenue; it's a ledger reclass. Tax will need to approve the reclassification memo.
- FX: invoices 1123/1130 were billed in GBP; the original payment recorded in EUR created a revaluation of EUR 2,100 on 2026-12-31. We should post journals at the original transaction rates to avoid creating an extra FX hit; propose we use the closing rates from 2026-12-31 that Treasury provided.

I've attached GL_mapping_v2.xlsx with suggested account lines and the two journal rows prefilled. If Tax signs off, Mina can post JNL-2027-07-AC1 and JNL-2027-07-VAT1 as staged entries (do not finalize until approval).

Marcus Lin
Revenue Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: GL_mapping_v2.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unapplied credit on invoices + VAT reclass request

Thanks — I will queue the two manual journals as "Staged" and place a posting hold. ETA to have the staged entries ready for review: EOD 2027-07-15.

Small question: do we want the audit memo to include a copy of the original payment confirmation from AeroCloud? If so, I'll attach it to the journal when we submit for posting.

One-line: staging started.

— Mina
Senior AR Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unapplied credit on invoices + VAT reclass request

Approved: go ahead with the staged journals and include the audit note. Two approvals / requirements from my side before posting: 

1) Attach customer payment confirmation and the AeroCloud_applied_credit_report.pdf to each journal line.
2) In the journal memo include: rationale for reallocation, the original payment date, FX rate used (closing 2026-12-31), and a note that VAT reclass is only a ledger move with no revenue impact.

Marcus: please confirm the exact VAT cents to move (EUR 1,350?) and stamp the GL mapping. Mina: once Marcus confirms, post the journals on 2027-07-18 and set posting user to REDWOOD-AR-BATCH.

Thanks — looping Legal only if AeroCloud requests a formal amendment.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Accounting Operations
Redwood Inference
